## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D street-life game about learning to ride a CD 70, opening the garage and going out on the bike with clutch and gear shifting.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone Three.js browser game in `index.html`, with procedural 3D scenery and bike.
- Assumed a Lahore neighborhood setting and keyboard controls, with touchscreen alternatives.

## Work State

### Completed
- Built the street, house, movable garage shutter, opening front door, CD 70 motorcycle, rider, HUD, tutorial, and clutch/gear/throttle/brake/steering controls.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully; browser smoke test created a canvas without page errors.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Visual iteration is ongoing: inspected screenshot showed camera/framing and house-opening visibility issues; latest code edit changed the main house shell to leave the door and garage openings clear. The latest screenshot was captured but not yet inspected after that edit.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` could not launch because its expected Chromium installation was missing. Smoke tests instead used `/usr/bin/chromium` through Playwright.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the latest `screenshots/latest.jpg` and refine camera framing/scene visibility as needed.
2. Run a quick gameplay smoke test covering opening the shutter, mounting the bike, clutch-assisted shifting, and riding out.
3. Check `git status` and report the completed game and controls; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent visual check.

## Important Context
- Local test server was run using `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright smoke tests used `/usr/bin/chromium` with SwiftShader-related launch flags.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D street-life game about learning to ride a CD 70, opening the garage and going out on the bike with clutch and gear shifting.

## Requirements
- Deliver the playable game without clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks, viewport no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a standalone Three.js browser game in `index.html`, with procedural 3D scenery.
- Assumed a Lahore neighborhood setting, keyboard controls, and touchscreen alternatives.

## Work State

### Completed
- Built the street, house, movable garage shutter, opening front door, CD 70 motorcycle, rider, HUD, tutorial, and clutch/gear/throttle/brake/steering controls.
- Fixed the garage-opening interaction and overlapping garage-shell geometry.
- Improved initial camera framing and reduced renderer load for smoother gameplay.
- Verified gameplay path in Chromium: walk to shutter, open it, mount bike, select first gear, ride out, steer, and brake to a stop; no page errors.
- Captured and inspected `screenshots/latest.jpg`.

### Active
- Remove temporary `window.__debug` helper from `index.html`.
- Run final JavaScript syntax check and inspect `git status`.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` could not launch because its expected Chromium installation was missing; browser tests use `/usr/bin/chromium` through Playwright instead.

## Next Move
1. Remove temporary `window.__debug` from `index.html`.
2. Run the JavaScript syntax check and verify `git status`.
3. If making further visual changes, capture and inspect only the latest JPEG screenshot.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation and current gameplay/camera edits.
- `screenshots/latest.jpg`: Most recent visual check.

## Important Context
- Local test server: `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Playwright smoke tests used `/usr/bin/chromium` with SwiftShader-related launch flags.
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status` previously showed untracked `.gitignore`, `Agents.md`, `capture.sh`, `index.html`, `start.sh`, and `startup.sh`.

from pathlib import Path
import re
text=Path('index.html').read_text()
scripts=re.findall(r'<script type="module">(.*?)</script>', text, re.S)
assert len(scripts)==1, f'expected one module script, got {len(scripts)}'
Path('/tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs').write_text(scripts[0])
PY
node --check /tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs
grep -n '__debug' index.html || true

Completed the playable CD 70 street-life game in `index.html`. Final JavaScript syntax check passed, and the temporary debug helper has been removed. The browser smoke test verified opening the garage, mounting the bike, shifting into first gear, riding out, steering, and braking to a stop without page errors.

The latest visual check is `screenshots/latest.jpg`. The game files remain uncommitted.
